title: GeyserFixes
description: Make the experience of your bedrock players actually good. (Fixes the long standing gameplay ruining issues for bedrock players on geyserMC and Fabric server)
body:
# **GeyserFixes** GeyserFixes is a lightweight utility for Fabric servers that improves the experience for Bedrock Edition players joining via GeyserMC. It resolves a lot of gameplay issues that make it insanely annoying to play as a bedrock player. NOTE: this might make the server more cheatable if the bedrock players use a hack client, so I suggest against using this on large servers, this is meant to be for private or small servers where you trust the bedrock players to not try cheating with modded client (even tho majority bedrock players don't do this lmao). ## **Core Features** ### **Enhanced Inventory Sorting** Bedrock players expects the items to be sorted from top left, while java does bottom right in hotbar, this causes weird issues occasionaly, this mod fixes this. and it also tries to make shift-click actually work properly, normal geyser gets very buggy and basically cancels any shift click where stack is not completely full already. ### **Movement Stability and Anti-Rubberbanding** Fixes common "getting stuck in random blocks" issue where Bedrock players' movements are cancelled for slightly clipping into blocks due to translation. Players will no longer get stuck below lanterns, or randomly walking up the hill. It also has a failsfe that enables the check for a small time so they repawn correctly. ### **Smart Spawn Protection** Provides temporary invulnerability to all players upon joining or respawning. this is because bedrock players take a lot longer on loading screen while server considers them in-game, leading to deaths not in control. * Protection lasts for up to 30 seconds or more (configurable) * Automatically expires if the player moves, interacts with blocks, or attacks. * This also applies to java players as its just a fail safe, doesn't effect anything. ## **Utility Commands** Some Commands that are very valuable for bedrock players. * **/offhand**: Instantly swaps the item in your main hand with your offhand. In latest stable bedrock, players on pc can set this as a keybind with macro controls under keyboard settings. * **/chunkreload or /r**: Forces chunk Reload for the player. This is a vital tool for fixing the issue where randomly, the chunks just stop loading until we leave and rejoin, now just run the command and chunk loading is 100% fixed. ## **Requirements** * Fabric, Areed's Corelib * GeyserMC and Floodgate (to identify and patch Bedrock players). *** **If you want a cheap and extremely good server, check out gravelhost, use my link or the code for 25% off for your purchase.**  [![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1376188/description_ab3820b9-fecf-4a0c-9f15-576b2c9c0323.png)](https://gravelhost.com/areedelahi) ***
